assertions.evidence: The code uses numeric outputs (e.g., const spamProbability = body.answers.spam.noul) and compares to thresholds, with no .includes or other string parsing.
The request defines two separate noul questions: questions: { spam: { type: "noul", ... }, abusive: { type: "noul", ... } }.
Threshold constants are defined in code (const SPAM_THRESHOLD = 0.7; const ABUSIVE_THRESHOLD = 0.7) and used right next to where probabilities are read and returned.
